title: Parse Mini statements
description: These methods select statement parsers and construct statement and block AST nodes.

steps.description: parse_program collects statements through EOF. parse_stmt selects a parser from the next token kind.
The let and function parsers consume their required syntax and return LetStmt or FunDef nodes.
The if parser records an optional else block. The while parser records its condition and body.
Return, print, and expression statements consume an expression and required semicolon.
parse_block reads statements through a closing brace. _parse_params reads a comma-separated identifier list.
